status: P01 and P04 active for cover trials; P03 not taken forward after contextual review

review.method: Distributed sampling, then targeted follow-up and full-resolution inspection; not exhaustive playback
review.coverage: June, July, August and September 2026 gardening footage on Videos; earlier mounted-drive photo inventory reused
review.online_limit: Fresh YouTube/channel access was throttled. These selections come from local camera originals and archive photos.
review.timestamp_note: Times are seek positions in raw camera files, not timestamps in edited YouTube episodes.
review.rejected_details: The sweetcorn close-up resolved into a leaf rather than a recognisable cob. Lifted garlic was less effective as a narrow band. Neither is in the delivered selection.

recommendation: Current requested proposal: P04 flowers above, P01 tomatoes below; preserve the centre and sticker.
